description: Aura Phase-N = masterplan deferral from Phase 6 (Tool Experience Loop): lesson promotion live + internal/learning wired end-to-end. Closes the loop tool_attempts -> aggregated lesson candidates -> proposed_updates (kind='operational_memory') -> operator approval -> operational memory write -> recall_operational LLM tool. The Phase 6 backbone (tool_attempts table, ToolObservation contract, Repo.Record, WarningsReader, briefer) is ALREADY shipped (commits 73ddea04..fa7d4559); Phase-N adds the missing aggregation + promotion + retrieval pieces. 4 atomic stories, one commit each on master. Pattern carried over from Phase-K/L/M: additive migrations, tests lock the contract, single-seam writers. Reference docs in tree (canonical): prd.md §5.8 internal/learning (lines 751-802) — minimum loop is 'tool failure -> structured feedback -> retry in same run -> persist outcome -> retrieve similar lesson later -> promote only after validation'. prd.md §5.7 lines 691-693 layer movement experience_store -> operational/skills via validation. prd.md Phase 6 line 1394 'promote repeated lessons into memory, skills, or tool policy only after validation'. docs/phase07c-mem0-elysia-patterns-2026-05-16.md §1.1 Mem0 history table append-only audit log pattern.

userStories.title: Add LessonCandidate + Repo.AggregateForPromotion in internal/agent/tools/attempts
userStories.description: Extend the existing `internal/agent/tools/attempts/` package with a lesson-promotion aggregator. Pure types + storage query + tests; no caller integration in this story. (a) New file `internal/agent/tools/attempts/aggregator.go` with: type `LessonCandidate struct { ToolName, ToolKind, ErrorClass string; Reason string; AttemptCount int; FirstSeen, LastSeen time.Time; SampleAttemptIDs []string; SignatureHash string }`. SignatureHash = sha256(tool_name + tool_kind + error_class + reason)[:16]. (b) Extend `Repo` interface in `internal/agent/tools/attempts/repo.go:32-46` with new method: `AggregateForPromotion(ctx context.Context, minOccurrences int, sinceDays int) ([]LessonCandidate, error)`. Implementation queries tool_attempts table for outcome='recoverable_error' or 'blocked_error' rows newer than (now - sinceDays days), groups by (tool_name, tool_kind, class, reason), filters HAVING COUNT(*) >= minOccurrences, returns one LessonCandidate per group with first 5 attempt IDs as samples. (c) Implement `AggregateForPromotion` on `SQLiteRepo` in `internal/agent/tools/attempts/sqlite.go` using a single SELECT with GROUP BY HAVING. (d) NO consumer wiring: do not touch executor, loop, cron, api in this story. (e) Tests in `internal/agent/tools/attempts/aggregator_test.go`: 5 cases — empty store returns empty slice; below threshold returns empty; above threshold returns 1 LessonCandidate with AttemptCount>=3 and correct SignatureHash; multi-group fixture returns multiple candidates ordered by AttemptCount DESC; sinceDays filter excludes old rows.

userStories.title: Wire learning.PromoteLessons + cron task that writes operational_memory proposals
userStories.description: Make the aggregator LIVE via a scheduled task that reads aggregated lesson candidates and creates review-gated proposals. (a) New file `internal/learning/promoter.go` with package `learning`. Function `PromoteLessons(ctx context.Context, repo attempts.Repo, proposalStore ProposalStore, minOccurrences int, sinceDays int) (promoted int, skipped int, err error)`. (b) `ProposalStore` interface (small abstraction in the same file): `CreateOperationalMemoryProposal(ctx context.Context, params CreateProposalParams) (created bool, err error)` where params include SignatureHash (for idempotency), Summary string, ToolName, ErrorClass, AttemptCount int, SampleAttemptIDs []string, FirstSeen, LastSeen time.Time. Implementation must skip-and-return-false if a proposed_updates row with the same signature_hash already exists. (c) Implementation: call repo.AggregateForPromotion(minOccurrences=3, sinceDays=7). For each LessonCandidate, build a summary text: 'Tool `<name>` repeated `<error_class>` failures (<count> times in last <days> days). Reason pattern: <reason>. Sample attempts: <ids>.' Then call proposalStore.CreateOperationalMemoryProposal with signature_hash. Return (promoted, skipped, nil). (d) Adapter `internal/learning/proposal_adapter.go` implementing ProposalStore on top of the existing proposed_updates SQLite table — locate via grep 'proposed_updates' in internal/conversation/summarizer/ or internal/db/migrations/. If the existing table has no kind column or no signature_hash column, add migration v14 with the minimal additive change (kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'wiki', signature_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''). (e) Wire `learning.PromoteLessons` into cron as kind 'lesson_promotion' running daily at 02:00 local — locate the cron task registry pattern via `internal/cron/types.go:32` and existing wiki_maintenance wiring. (f) Tests in `internal/learning/promoter_test.go`: 4 cases — empty repo: promoted=0; 1 candidate above threshold: promoted=1; rerun same data: promoted=0, skipped=1 (idempotency via signature_hash); 3 candidates: promoted=3.

userStories.title: Approved operational_memory proposals write to compact_memory_documents kind=operational
userStories.description: Close the layer movement experience_store -> operational_memory via validation. When an operator approves a proposed_updates row with kind='operational_memory', a new function in `internal/learning/writer.go` writes it as a compact_memory_documents row with kind='operational' (Phase 7B US-L01 CollectionOperational scaffold becomes finally wired). (a) New file `internal/learning/writer.go` with function `WriteApprovedLesson(ctx context.Context, store memoryindex.Store, proposal Proposal) error`. Builds a memoryindex.Document with Kind=memoryindex.KindOperational, Title='Lesson: <tool> <error_class>', Body=summary text, Handle='operational:<signature_hash>', Status='active', UpdatedAt=now, ContentHash from Phase 7C US-M02 ContentHash helper, EmbeddingModelID + IndexBuildID from current projection_state row of compact_memory_documents (via Phase 7C US-M03 freshness.Store). (b) Use memoryindex.Store.WriteOne(doc) — if no such method exists, add a small helper that uses INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE on the single-row signature_hash-keyed ID. (c) Locate the existing applier path: `internal/conversation/summarizer/applier.go` (or sibling). Add a hook in the approval-transition code so when proposal.Kind == 'operational_memory' and status flips from 'pending' to 'approved', WriteApprovedLesson is invoked. (d) The compact_memory_documents row gets indexed via existing rebuild/sync flow — no separate FTS/Qdrant work needed. (e) NO new tables. (f) Tests in `internal/learning/writer_test.go`: 3 cases — approve operational_memory proposal: compact_memory_documents row created with kind='operational' and correct Handle; double-approve: idempotent (single row, no duplicate); approve non-operational kind: no-op (returns nil without write).

userStories.title: Add recall_operational LLM tool + Phase 6 lesson promotion closure docs
userStories.description: Make operational lessons retrievable by the agent + close the Phase 6 deferral. (a) New file `internal/agent/tools/registry/recall_operational.go` with `RecallOperationalTool` struct + Definition + Execute. Schema: { 'query': string optional, 'tool_name': string optional, 'error_class': string optional, 'limit': int default 5 max 20 }.
